--fsds-card-design-root-spacing-gap .ret.decision: Pinterest pin cards are chromeless compositions: 6px caption stack gap vs the 12px base card gap (feed reference: image-led cards, caption tight under media).

--fsds-card-design-root-spacing-padding.decision: Pinterest: padding 0 — the artwork is the card face; the base 12px pads the music-page album cards.

--fsds-card-design-content-spacing-gap ..decision: Pinterest captions use a 2px title/artist gap vs the 4px base (denser feed reference).

--fsds-tooltip-design-content-background.decision: Retain the generated Tooltip dark surface for the library collapse hint; source-derived fallback, without a full accessibility adequacy claim.

--fsds-tooltip-design-content-foreground.decision: Retain the generated Tooltip light text for the library collapse hint; source-derived fallback.

--fsds-tooltip-design-content-border-col.decision: Retain the generated Tooltip border fallback; source-derived fallback, not a rendered border-consumption claim.
